$comment: BTCC 1991 maker and tyre logos for tools/logo_art.py (assets/engines, assets/tyre, and the team list icons in assets/logos). commons = logo file on Wikimedia Commons (licence, author and period recorded); crest = plain text crest where no free period logo exists. Each logo is the version in use when the make or tyre maker raced in the BTCC (1991, or the year a later make joins through real_history). period = the years the design was in use, from the Commons file page and Logopedia. "team_tiles": "maker": as in dtm-2013, every team (also the later teams from docs/teams/btcc_game_events.csv) shows its make's emblem as its list icon. The teams' own logos are not in the game (wishlist E18). Sizes as bases/dtm-era4: team_content 938, outline 20 px at 50%. Doubts are in each "note" and in seasons/btcc-1991/README.md.

BMW.note: the flat roundel with the older letters, as on the 1991 M3s (the chrome-edged roundel came in 1997)

Ford.note: the flat blue oval with white script, as on the 1991 Sierras (the shaded Centennial oval came in 2003)

Vauxhall.author: TheCrimsonBoat
Vauxhall.note: the griffin in the red disc, as on the 1991 Cavalier doors; the VAUXHALL word below it is cut off

Toyota.note: emblem stacked over the red TOYOTA word; the emblem was new in 1989 and on the 1991 Carinas

Nissan.note: the blue box wordmark with the small roundel; the 1991 Primeras carried NISSAN in this lettering

Mitsubishi.period: three diamonds since 1914; this Mitsubishi Motors lockup 1982-2017
Mitsubishi.note: the three red diamonds; the MITSUBISHI MOTORS words below are cut off

Peugeot.author: Flexingflex1224
Peugeot.note: the white lion in the blue box, as used when Peugeot joined in 1992; the PEUGEOT word below is cut off

Mazda.note: the rounded emblem and mazda wordmark of 1992, when Mazda joined (the diamond emblem of 1991 was dropped in 1992)

Renault.note: UNSURE: the Vasarely line diamond, in use until 1992. Renault joined in 1993, by then with the new solid diamond (File:Renault 1992-2004 logo.png, CC0), which Commons would not serve here (rate limit). Swap it in when it downloads. Black lines are light grey here for the dark screens.

Volvo.period: spread VOLVO wordmark, in use from the 1950s to 2020
Volvo.note: the blue VOLVO word; the 850s of 1994 carried the iron mark grille badge, which has no free period file

Alfa Romeo.note: No free file of the 1982-2015 badge exists (Commons only has a photo of a badge, CC BY-SA). Plain text crest in the badge colours.

Honda.period: red HONDA wordmark, in use since the 1970s
Honda.note: UNSURE: the red HONDA word only, cut from the motorcycle wing logo. The car H badge of 1995 has no free period file (Commons has only the 2000 and later versions).

Audi.note: the chrome rings of the 1995 logo, as on the 1996 A4s; the Audi word is cut off (same as bases/dtm-era4)

Yokohama.note: red Y chevron stacked over the word; the black word is white here for the dark screens

Dunlop.note: flying D stacked over the word; black is white here. The 1991 Vauxhall and Nissan cars showed the word alone.

Pirelli.note: black letters made Pirelli yellow for the dark screens, as on the period trackside boards

Firestone.period: script in use for most of the 20th century
Firestone.note: red Firestone script, as on the 1991 Mitsubishi bonnet

Bridgestone.note: black letters made white for the dark screens; the red B tip stays

Michelin.period: UNSURE: italic blue MICHELIN wordmark; this file is dated 2012 and the 1991 lettering may differ a little
